feeds.title: Calmer Blog
feeds.description: Discover a range of insights on the Calmer blog, with wellbeing articles from practitioners, experts, and official Calmer partners. Calmer is an award-winning training organisation, empowering entrepreneurs, freelancers and business teams to nurture good mental health and wellbeing.

feeds.title: Mind Share Partners Blog
feeds.description: Mind Share Partners corporate health and wellness blog featuring noted authors and articles about workplace depression, stress and anxiety. Mind Share Partners is a national nonprofit changing the culture of workplace mental health so that both employees and organizations can thrive.

feeds.title: MHAW
feeds.description: Discover our blog, news articles and success stories to see what is happening in the world of workplace mental health. We develop & deliver practical, skills-based, virtual training programs that empower organizations to understand, manage and promote mental health.

feeds.title: Silver Oak Health
feeds.description: Employees leave organizations for a number of reasons, and a lack of focus on employee mental health is one of them. Read this blog to find out about Workplace Mental Health. Silver Oak Health is a provider of Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & Prevention Of Sexual Harassment (POSH) services in India.

feeds.title: Work Well Being Blog
feeds.description: Corporate wellbeing news and views providing inspiration for workplace wellbeing programmes and strategies. Work Well Being is a network of top-class wellbeing experts who together are intent on enhancing the way we live our lives and shaping the future of work - for individuals and business.

feeds.title: Blooming Minds Blog
feeds.description: Articles to help you foster positive mental health in the workplace, improving employee mental health and productivity and minimise psychological risk. Blooming Minds partner with your organisation to develop positive workpalce mental health, so you can meet your obligations for employee mental health.

feeds.title: Mental Health In The Workplace Blog
feeds.description: A mental health blog for employees and employers. We are Mental Health In The Workplace, a training provider, co-founded by Gary Johannes and Tamsen Garrie, both of whom have been supporting organisations and the well-being and development of the people who work within them, for longer than we can remember.

feeds.title: Neuvana Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about neuroscience, vagus nerve stimulation & Xen. Our team works to provide the highest quality information to help you. At Neuvana we strive to continually improve people's lives through Neuroscience. Our products provide increased overall wellness - calmness, balance, and rejuvenation.

feeds.title: Calm Health Blog
feeds.description: Insight and inspiration to create a more mindful, resilient workplace. Calm is the #1 app for mental fitness, designed to help you manage stress, sleep better and live a happier, healthier life.

feeds.title: Workplace Mental Health Institute Blog
feeds.description: Mental health blogs focused on workplace & corporate culture, mental health strategies, policies & practices, mindfulness, wellbeing, stigma, anxiety, depression, stress and all the mental health problems. Workplace Mental Health Institute helps organisations to develop a better workplace mental health program in Australia.

feeds.title: Healthy Office Habits
feeds.description: The Healthy Office Habits blog is your go-to resource for reliable, up-to-date, unique, experience-based, applicableinformation on the habits that matter most for your workplace's physical, mental, and behavioral well-being.

feeds.title: In Equilibrium Blog
feeds.description: Articles, resources & tips in the areas of resilience, managing stress at work, mental health awareness & preventing bullying. In Equilibrium is a training and consultancy organisation. We provide in-house courses in Mental Health Awareness, Developing Resilience, Managing Stress, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion and Tackling Bullying & Harassment throughout the UK.
